briefdescription.para: Perhaps branch folding, tail merging and other CFG optimizations on the given function.

detaileddescription.para: Block placement changes the layout and may create new tail merging opportunities.

briefdescription.para: Delete the instruction OldInst and everything after it, replacing it with an unconditional branch to NewDest.
Given a machine basic block and an iterator into it, split the MBB so that the part before the iterator falls into the part starting at the iterator.
Look through all the blocks in MergePotentials that have hash CurHash (guaranteed to match the last element).

detaileddescription.para: Build the vector SameTails of all those that have the (same) largest number of instructions in common of any pair of these blocks. SameTails entries contain an iterator into MergePotentials (from which the MachineBasicBlock can be found) and a MachineBasicBlock::iterator into that MBB indicating the instruction where the matching code sequence begins. Order of elements in SameTails is the reverse of the order in which those blocks appear in MergePotentials (where they are not necessarily consecutive).

briefdescription.para: Remove all blocks with hash CurHash from MergePotentials, restoring branches at ends of blocks as appropriate.
None of the blocks to be tail-merged consist only of the common tail.

detaileddescription.para: Create a block that does by splitting one.

briefdescription.para: Create merged DebugLocs of identical instructions across SameTails and assign it to the instruction in common tail; merge MMOs and undef flags.
Analyze and optimize control flow related to the specified block.

detaileddescription.para: This is never called on the entry block.

briefdescription.para: Remove the specified dead machine basic block from the function, updating the CFG.
Hoist common instruction sequences at the start of basic blocks to their common predecessor.
If the successors of MBB has common instruction sequence at the start of the function, move the instructions before MBB terminator if it's legal.
